e.title: **一部法令**一个 **XML****，**并**在根元素上**写着**它有多少条条文****：`legislation.gov.uk`——**⭐ 本次实测**《**金融服务与市场法 **2000**》**的 **XML **20,878,291 字节**、**逐字含 **`NumberOfProvisions="1903"`****；**《**金融服务法 **2012**》** **5,157,940 字节**、**条文数 **`1348`****；**⭐ 并**可按标题**检索**（**逐字题含**「**Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) Act 2022**」与**四部 **`National Insurance Contributions`** 法**）**；**⚠️ 而**该检索**会把**英国「**国民保险**」（**社保缴费）**与**商业保险**混在一起****
e.title_en: One act of parliament, one XML document, with the number of provisions written on the root element: measured this round as a twenty-megabyte file for the financial services and markets act carrying a provision count just under two thousand, a five-megabyte file for the 2012 financial services act with a smaller count, and title search that returns compulsory motor insurance legislation alongside four acts about national insurance contributions, which in that jurisdiction means social security rather than insurance business.
e.title_hk: **一部法令**一個 **XML****，**並**在根元素上**寫著**它有多少條條文****：`legislation.gov.uk`——**⭐ 本次實測**《**金融服務與市場法 2000**》**的 XML 20,878,291 位元組**、**逐字含 `NumberOfProvisions="1903"`****；**《**金融服務法 2012**》** 5,157,940 位元組**、**條文數 1348****；**⭐ 並**可按標題檢索**；**⚠️ 而**該檢索**會把**英國「**國民保險**」（**社保繳費）**與**商業保險**混在一起****
e.summary: **legislation.gov.uk**（英国法例官方网站的数据接口）**是一个**把**议会法令**做成**可编程取用文本**的站点****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**一部法令**对应**一个 **XML 文档**，**且**根元素上**逐字带条文数**（**`NumberOfProvisions`**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**法规文本的可编程接口**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **⭐ 整部法令**可以**一次取回**，**而**体量**与**条文数**都在**根元素上写明****——**⭐ 本次实测**《**金融服务与市场法 **2000**》（**`ukpga/2000/8`）**返回 **200**、**20,878,291 字节**（**约 **20.9 MB**）**、**逐字含 **`NumberOfProvisions="1903"`****；**《**金融服务法 **2012**》（**`ukpga/2012/7`）**返回 **200**、**5,157,940 字节**、**条文数 **`1348`****；**另一个**本次**随机取的**法令**返回 **41,123 字节**、**条文数 **`9`****——**⭐ 即**「**先看条文数**」**再决定**要不要**下载**，**是**这里**很自然的一个动作**；**② **⭐ 根元素**还带**两个可核对的标识**（**逐字** `DocumentURI` 与 **`IdURI`**，**形如 **`legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2012/7` 与 **`.../id/ukpga/2012/7`**）**——**⭐ 即**同一部法令**有**「**文档地址**」与**「**标识地址**」**两种形式**；**③ **⭐ 可按标题检索**（**Atom 提要**）**——**本次实测** `ukpga/data.feed?title=insurance`** 返回 **200**、**57,246 字节****，**逐字取到**五项标题**，**其中**「**Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) Act 2022**」**是**保险立法**；**④ **⚠️ 而**其中四部**是**「**National Insurance Contributions**」**系列法**（**2023／**2024／**2025／**2026**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 在英国语境里 **National Insurance **指的是**社保缴费**，**与**商业保险**不是一回事**——**⭐ 故**按 **insurance** 一词检索时**必须**逐条分辨**。**⚠️ 本次**未下载**任何**法令全文**。
e.summary_hk: **legislation.gov.uk**（英國法例官方網站的數據介面）**是一個**把**議會法令**做成**可編程取用文本**的站點****——**⭐ 本次實測**：**一部法令**對應**一個 XML 文檔**，**且**根元素上**逐字帶條文數（**`NumberOfProvisions`**）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**法規文本的可編程介面**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **⭐ 整部法令可以一次取回**，**體量與條文數都在根元素上寫明**——**《金融服務與市場法 2000》返回 200、**20,878,291 位元組、**逐字含 `NumberOfProvisions="1903"`****；**《金融服務法 2012》返回 200、**5,157,940 位元組、**條文數 1348****；**另一個隨機取的法令為 41,123 位元組、**條文數 9****；**② **⭐ 根元素帶兩個可核對標識**（**逐字 `DocumentURI` 與 `IdURI`**）**；**③ **⭐ 可按標題檢索（**Atom 提要**）**——**`ukpga/data.feed?title=insurance` 返回 200、**57,246 位元組**，**逐字取到五項標題**，**其中 Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) Act 2022 是保險立法**；**④ **⚠️ 而其中四部是 National Insurance Contributions 系列法**——**⭐ 在英國語境裡 National Insurance 指社保繳費**，**與商業保險不是一回事**——**⭐ 故**按 insurance 檢索時必須逐條分辨**。**⚠️ 本次**未下載任何法令全文**。
e.summary_en: This site **exposes acts of parliament as text that can be fetched programmatically**, with one XML document per act and the provision count written on the root element. **This entry belongs to the round theme of programmable interfaces to legal text.** **Four things are worth reading: an entire act can be retrieved in one request, and both its size and its provision count are stated on the root element, measured here as about twenty-one megabytes and just under two thousand provisions for the financial services and markets act, about five megabytes and roughly thirteen hundred provisions for the 2012 financial services act, and forty kilobytes with nine provisions for another act picked at random, so checking the provision count before downloading is a natural move; the root element also carries two checkable identifiers, a document address and an identifier address; title search works through an Atom feed, returning five titles for the word insurance, among them compulsory motor insurance legislation; and four of those five are acts about national insurance contributions, which in that jurisdiction means social security contributions rather than insurance business, so a search on the word insurance has to be read item by item.** **No full text was downloaded this round.**
e.body:
**legislation.gov.uk**（英国法例官方网站的数据接口）**是一个**把**议会法令**做成**可编程取用文本**的站点****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**一部法令**对应**一个 **XML 文档**，**且**根元素上**逐字带条文数**（**`NumberOfProvisions`**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**法规文本的可编程接口**」**。

**可核实信息（均本次只读取用实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 整部法令一次取回，**而**体量与**条文数**写在**根元素上****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**《**金融服务与市场法 **2000**》（**路径 **`ukpga/2000/8/data.xml`）**返回 **200**、**20,878,291 字节**（**约 **20.9 MB**）**、**根元素逐字含 **`NumberOfProvisions="1903"`****；**《**金融服务法 **2012**》（**`ukpga/2012/7/data.xml`）**返回 **200**、**5,157,940 字节**、**逐字 **`NumberOfProvisions="1348"`****；**另一个**本次**随机取的**法令**返回 **200**、**41,123 字节**、**条文数 **`9`****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**在**取**一整部**法令之前**，**调用者**可以**只看**根元素的**一个数字**，**就**知道**它**有多大**、**有多少条**——**⭐ 这**与**本会话**第 366 轮记下的**「**先读**镜像配置**再决定**要不要拉**」**是**同一类**判断动作**。**⭐⭐ ② 根元素带**两个可核对的标识****——**⭐ 本次实测**其**根元素逐字含** `DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2012/7"` 与 **`IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2012/7"`****；**⭐ 另**逐字含 **`xml:lang="en"`** 与**命名空间声明 **`xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation"`****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**同一条**法令**有**「**文档地址**」与**「**标识地址**」**两种形式**——**⭐ 对**引用**而言**，**后者**更**稳定**（**⭐ 与**本会话**多次记下的**「**锁住标识**」**同向**）**。**⭐⭐ ③ 可按标题检索，**而**结果里**正好**暴露**一处**同名异物****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**`https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/data.feed?title=insurance`** 返回 **200**、**57,246 字节**（**Atom 提要**）**，**逐字取到的**标题含**「**Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) Act 2022**」**，**以及**四部**「**National Insurance Contributions**」**系列法**（**逐字**「**National Insurance Contributions (Employer Pensions Contributions) Act 2026**」**、**「**National Insurance Contributions (Secondary Class 1 Contributions) Act 2025**」**、**「**National Insurance Contributions (Reduction in Rates) Act 2024**」与**「**National Insurance Contributions (Reduction in Rates) Act 2023**」**）**。**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**在英国**语境里 **National Insurance **是**社保缴费**（**由 **HMRC 征收）**，**与**商业保险**不是一回事**——**⭐ 故**在**英文法例库**里**按 **insurance** 检索，**必须**逐条**分辨**是**「**保险业务**」**还是**「**国民保险**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[data-gov-au]]、**[[data-europa]]、**[[fred]] 覆盖**政府数据接口**、**[[ans-tiss-standard]] 与**[[risk-data-library-standard]] 覆盖**标准文本**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**一部法令一个 **XML、**并**把**条文数**写在**根元素上**的**英文法例接口**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **取长文本前**先看**元数据里的**规模指标**（**此处为**条文数**）**；**② **引用**用**稳定标识**，**而**不是**文档路径**；**③ **按词检索**必须**分辨**同名的**不同制度**（**本条为 **National Insurance）**；**④ **法例文本**要**以**官方站点**为准**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载**任何**法令的**全文**（**⭐ 三个 **XML** 只**取了**头部与前若干字节用于核对根元素**）**，**故**不主张**其**文本内容**、**不主张**其**版本状态**（**如**是否**已修订**）**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**该站点返回的 **XML 与 **Atom 提要**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**修订（**as amended）与**原始版本**的**区别与**取用方式**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**使用条款与**频率限制**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**本文中**取到的**五部法令**的**具体内容**（**⭐ 本条**只记录**标题与**接口行为**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该站点**提供的是**英国法例文本**，**不构成**法律意见**。
e.body_hk:
**legislation.gov.uk**（英國法例官方網站的數據介面）**是一個**把**議會法令**做成**可編程取用文本**的站點****——**⭐ 本次實測**：**一部法令**對應**一個 XML 文檔**，**且**根元素上**逐字帶條文數（**`NumberOfProvisions`**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**法規文本的可編程介面**」**。

**可核實資訊（均本次只讀取用實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 整部法令一次取回，**而體量與條文數寫在根元素上****——**《金融服務與市場法 2000》（**`ukpga/2000/8/data.xml`）返回 200、**20,878,291 位元組（**約 20.9 MB**）、**根元素逐字含 `NumberOfProvisions="1903"`****；**《金融服務法 2012》（**`ukpga/2012/7/data.xml`）返回 200、**5,157,940 位元組、**逐字 `NumberOfProvisions="1348"`****；**另一個隨機取的法令返回 200、**41,123 位元組、**條文數 9****。**⭐ 即**在取一整部法令之前**，**只看根元素一個數字就知道它有多大、**有多少條**。**⭐⭐ ② 根元素帶兩個可核對標識****——**逐字含 `DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2012/7"` 與 `IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2012/7"`**，**另含 `xml:lang="en"` 與命名空間聲明****——**⭐ 即**同一法令有「**文檔位址**」與「**標識位址**」兩種形式**，**引用時後者更穩定**。**⭐⭐ ③ 可按標題檢索，**而結果正好暴露一處同名異物****——**`ukpga/data.feed?title=insurance` 返回 200、**57,246 位元組****，**逐字取到 Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) Act 2022**，**以及四部 National Insurance Contributions 系列法**（**2023／2024／2025／2026**）**——**⭐ 在英國語境裡 National Insurance 指社保繳費**（**由 HMRC 徵收）**，**與商業保險不是一回事**——**⭐ 故**按 insurance 檢索時必須逐條分辨**。**⭐⭐ ④ 與池內條目的關係**：[[data-gov-au]]、[[data-europa]]、[[fred]]、[[ans-tiss-standard]]、[[risk-data-library-standard]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**以一部法令一個 XML、**並把條文數寫在根元素上的英文法例介面**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **取長文本前先看規模指標**；**② **引用用穩定標識**；**③ **按詞檢索要分辨同名制度**；**④ **法例文本以官方站點為準**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有下載任何法令的全文**（**三個 XML 只取了頭部與前若干位元組用於核對根元素**）**，**不主張**其文本內容**，**也不主張**其版本狀態（**如是否已修訂**）**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀該站點返回的 XML 與 Atom 提要**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其修訂（**as amended）與原始版本的區別與取用方式**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其使用條款與頻率限制**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**本文中取到的五部法令的具體內容**（**只記錄標題與介面行為**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該站點提供英國法例文本**，**不構成法律意見**。
e.body_en:
This site **exposes acts of parliament as text that can be fetched programmatically**, with one XML document per act and the provision count written on the root element. **This entry belongs to the round theme of programmable interfaces to legal text.**

**Verified information, all from read-only fetches made this round**: **first, an entire act can be retrieved in one request, and both its size and its provision count are stated on the root element.** The financial services and markets act returned a twenty-megabyte document carrying a provision count of one thousand nine hundred and three, the 2012 financial services act returned about five megabytes with a count of one thousand three hundred and forty-eight, and another act picked at random returned forty kilobytes with nine provisions. **A caller can therefore read one number on the root element and know how large an act is and how many provisions it contains before fetching it, which is the same class of decision as reading an image configuration before pulling it, recorded elsewhere in this session.** **Second, the root element carries two checkable identifiers**, a document address and an identifier address, along with a language attribute and a namespace declaration. **An act therefore has two addressing forms, and for citation the identifier form is the more stable, consistent with the rule recorded repeatedly in this session of locking onto identifiers.** **Third, title search works and its results happen to expose a homonym.** An Atom feed for the word insurance returned five titles, among them compulsory motor insurance legislation, and **four acts about national insurance contributions from 2023 through 2026. In that jurisdiction national insurance means social security contributions collected by the tax authority rather than insurance business, so a search on the word insurance in an English-language statute database must be read item by item to separate insurance business from national insurance.** **Fourth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover government data interfaces and standard documents, **while this entry supplies an English-language statute interface with one XML per act and the provision count on the root element. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: check a size indicator in the metadata, here the provision count, before fetching a long text; cite a stable identifier rather than a document path; when searching by word, distinguish institutions that share a name, as national insurance does here; and treat the official site as the authoritative source of statute text.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no full text of any act was downloaded**, only the head of three XML documents being read to check the root element, **so no claim is made about their contents or about their version status, such as whether they are already amended**. **Second, only the XML and Atom responses returned by the site were read.** **Third, the difference between amended and original versions, and how to request each, was not verified. Fourth, its terms of use and rate limits were not verified. Fifth, the contents of the five acts returned here were not verified**, only their titles and the interface behaviour being recorded. **Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the site provides United Kingdom statute text and does not constitute legal advice.**
e.verified_note: 实测核实（本次只读取用，均返回 200）：① https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2000/8/data.xml 返回 200、20,878,291 字节，根元素逐字含 NumberOfProvisions="1903" ② https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2012/7/data.xml 返回 200、5,157,940 字节，逐字含 NumberOfProvisions="1348"、DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2012/7"、IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2012/7"、xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation"、xml:lang="en" ③ https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2022/17/data.xml 返回 200、41,123 字节，条文数 9 ④ https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/data.feed?title=insurance 返回 200、57,246 字节（Atom 提要），逐字取到标题 Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) Act 2022、National Insurance Contributions (Employer Pensions Contributions) Act 2026、National Insurance Contributions (Secondary Class 1 Contributions) Act 2025、National Insurance Contributions (Reduction in Rates) Act 2024、National Insurance Contributions (Reduction in Rates) Act 2023｜⚠️本次没有下载任何法令的全文（三个 XML 只取了头部与前若干字节用于核对根元素），不主张其文本内容，也不主张其版本状态（如是否已修订）｜⚠️本次只读该站点返回的 XML 与 Atom 提要｜⚠️未核实其修订（as amended）与原始版本的取用方式与区别｜⚠️未核实其使用条款与频率限制，本词条不给出调用建议｜⚠️未核实本文中取到的五部法令的具体内容（只记录标题与接口行为）｜⚠️同名词提醒：英国语境里 National Insurance 指社保缴费（由 HMRC 征收），与商业保险无关，本词条据此指出按 insurance 检索必须逐条分辨｜⚠️窗口状况：本条描述的是接口本身而非某一文件，故无窗口内新增；缺口为「以一部法令一个 XML、并把条文数写在根元素上的英文法例接口」这一形态｜⚠️本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见；该站点提供英国法例文本，不构成法律意见
